_: Grades controls.test.mjs's own exit-code wiring. controls.test.mjs is itself registered in pipeline.json `guards` (base `controls`), so its blocking exit needs the same spawned red/green control every other guard needs — .claude/controls.repo.test.mjs carries them, spawning THIS script against synthetic fixture roots.

expectRed: a guard registered with a red control but no green control blocks
a guard wired in lefthook.yml but absent from the registry blocks
a suite path the registry names but that does not exist on disk blocks
a CONTROL test whose title is missing from expectRed blocks
a mutations.json whose suites omits the suite under test blocks
a mutations.json whose target does not equal the guard path blocks
a `.skip`-ed CONTROL test blocks — a control must run to be graded
mutations.note: The final blocking exit, dropped: every finding still prints as FAIL but the process exits 0 regardless. Reddens every test in controls.repo.test.mjs that asserts status 1 on a broken fixture, not only the CONTROL: red one — every other status-1 assertion in the suite is just as blind to a dropped exit.

expectRed: a guard registered with linked red and green controls passes

mutations.note: Unconditional exit 1, even when `failed` is 0 — a fully consistent registry would still read as broken. Reddens every test in controls.repo.test.mjs that asserts status 0, not only the CONTROL: green one.
